name: Natsume Jirou
source:
Principal of the Baramon High School.
When it comes to being an outlaw, Jirou and Teruhiko are neck in neck: this particular trait has indeed charmed dozens of students to enroll in said high school.
Jirou teaches the protagonist this game's system, such as offering save slots, as well as a top notch romantical support.

"Do you want to save here?"
